# Nsight Compute Basics for Kernel Authors

## Thesis

**Nsight Compute (`ncu`)** explains kernel slowness with occupancy, bandwidth, and stall metrics. **`ncu` was not run here** (no GPU).

## Mental model

```text
  ncu report → speed-of-light → stalls → fix memory first
```

## Worked examples

```bash
ncu --kernel-name regex:my_gemm --set full -o gemm ./bench
ncu -i gemm.ncu-rep
```

Start with Speed of Light; then stall reasons.

## Trap

**Profiling debug builds or tiny launches.** Noise dominates.

## Boring rule

One `ncu` report before large kernel rewrites.

## Try this

1. Compare `ncu` vs Nsight Systems.
2. Map Triton kernel names into reports.
3. Read NVIDIA Nsight Compute docs for your toolkit.
